description_expanded:
Gulf-front in Seagrove!

Just steps from the sugar-white sands

Private deck with Gulf views

4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms

4 bikes

Outdoor shower

Gas grill for al fresco dining

Gone Coastal by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Gone Coastal, your ultimate beachfront escape in Seagrove Beach. This exquisite 3-story townhouse offers a serene and inviting atmosphere, perfectly decorated to enhance your beachfront experience. The property features spacious living areas bathed in natural light, boasting an open floor plan that connects the living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen — ideal for entertaining. Outdoor living is exceptional here. Step onto your private deck to enjoy breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico, or relax with a morning coffee to the soothing sounds of the waves. Additionally, an outdoor grill awaits those perfect beachside barbecues. Surrounded by beauty, the townhouse sits between the Gulf of Mexico and Eastern Lake, offering abundant activities right at your doorstep. Enjoy lounging on the beach, swimming in the clear waters, or exploring 30A with our bicycles. With Gone Coastal, you’re near 4-star restaurants, charming boutiques, and world-class golf courses, offering a wonderful stay that's both exciting and relaxing. Welcome!

Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Seagrove Beach - Beachfront Townhome - Wi-Fi - Outdoor Shower - Gas Grill - 4 bikes - Parking for 4 Overnight: - First Floor Bedroom: Bunk bed (two full beds), a single twin bed, a futon, TV - Second Floor Primary: King bed, private bath; TV - Third Floor Primary: King bed, private bath, TV, small deck overlooking the gulf. - Third Floor Bedroom: Queen bed and two twins, private bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST
